Amanda — answered inline below and attaching final packet. See attachments: redwood_subprocessors_20270621.csv, apac_dataflow_export_routes.png, SOC2_attestation_redwood_2026.pdf. Also included a one-line routing blurb for your DPA.

1) AnalyticsCloud data flows: raw token-level logs are never exported to the US for ParcelPay APAC tenants by default. We apply local pseudonymization and aggregation at the SG collector (edge) before any cross-border export; export to US analytics is only for aggregated telemetry and requires an explicit onshore-fallback toggle per-tenant.

2) TelemetryBridgeInc (pilot): primary contact is Lucas Morton <lucas@telemetrybridge.inc>. Operational window: 2026-10-05 to 2027-02-28. No copies of ParcelPay data were retained after cutover; we have contract language confirming return & deletion and an executed exit certificate (referenced in CSV contract_ref column).

Routing blurb for DPA: "Redwood Inference routes telemetry and analytics for APAC tenants to APAC-located processors by default (Singapore). Cross-border export to non-APAC jurisdictions occurs only when a tenant enables an onshore-fallback setting or during explicitly documented maintenance/incident procedures; such exports are logged and require data controller approval."

If youd like, we can schedule a 30-minute walkthrough tomorrow morning PT to run through the packet with Legal & Security.

Best regards,
Irene
Privacy & Trust — Redwood Inference
